scope: Complete VR object atlas; first-level tile terrain and animation poses are prewarmed. Unused atlas poses do not imply a completed campaign.
geometry: Runtime closed rounded silhouettes with HD UVs; anatomical spider/frog/bird/platform recipes; existing jointed upright bear.

panorama.method: Built-in image_gen, photorealistic generated landscape; not a geographically accurate photograph.
panorama.prompt: Seamless 360-degree equirectangular forest-valley landscape. Everest-inspired snow peaks in one direction, Kilimanjaro-inspired massif opposite. Soft warm daylight, sky upper half, distant mountains at horizon, no structures, people, text or watermark. Requested highest resolution; tool returned 1774x887.
panorama.parallax: 180m sphere; center follows90% of horizontal viewer translation

limits: Depth and unseen rear anatomy are authored interpretations of 2D references, not recovered original 3D data.
3D collectible surfaces retain original HD texture motifs; no billboard facing camera.
Labels/HUD remain 2D UI. IDKFA intentionally marks secrets through walls.
